$meta.description: Source fields that carry data but which no normalizer reads, and that we accept. `npx tsx scripts/schema-gap-report.ts --assert` fails on anything NOT listed here, so a field the AR adds or renames breaks the build instead of being silently dropped.
$meta.howToUpdate: Only add an entry with a reason in `reasons`. If a field starts being read, remove it — --assert reports stale entries.

reasons.PeticoesXVII:PetLeg: Redundant: peticoes.legislatura_id is set from the legislature being loaded, which is the same value.
reasons.RegistoBiografico:CadNomeCompleto: Redundant: deputados.nome_completo already carries this, sourced from InformacaoBase.DepNomeCompleto.
